svg.title: Fold a distribution at its median to find MAD
svg.desc: Area shows reference weight. The upper illustrative curve shows log token counts x; its weighted median splits the weight in half, with the lower half shaded. The dashed curve shows that lower half folded over the median, where each value lands once its direction is ignored. The lower panel adds both halves on a distance axis, the absolute difference between x and the median, which starts directly under the median. Its own median, which again splits the weight in half, is the MAD; the shaded part lies within it. Both panels share one horizontal scale. The two-peaked shape is illustrative, not measured token data.
